node.title: The Attribution Gap and Capability Loss
node.reading:
Healthy, growing firms repeatedly destroy capabilities they still depend on — not the weakest applications in a portfolio, but, disproportionately, some of the strongest. This paper explains that paradox as an architecture problem, not a capability problem. In an enterprise, the real information flow (applications transforming information that contributes to what the enterprise sells, delivers, protects, or is required to maintain) and the architecture of that flow (the firm’s model of who contributes what, and who depends on whom) are two distinct levels. The capabilities live on the first level; rationalization decisions are made on the second. The central claim is that the architecture decays relative to reality — and that it decays for economic reasons, not technical ones. The wedge between the two is the attribution gap : the difference between an application’s contribution (the value it really adds, traceable through information lineage) and its attribution (the credit it receives, which is what moves budget). Because making a dependency explicit assigns the property right and transfers the rent to the source, every actor has a standing incentive to keep dependencies implicit while securing the inputs they rely on. Under that incentive the gap’s expected direction is widening across decision cycles — through a control-grab in bad times and a contest of heroes in good times — until the firm can no longer reliably see, on its own map, which capabilities are load-bearing. At the moment of the cut, even with information on the table, the decision turns on will: a governance body asks who will own and be accountable for the critical capability, and the answer is silence. The unowned high-contributor is cut, in the disguise of “retiring legacy” or “not deploying the new,” with its value still in it.

The paper proposes the firm-level theory as practice-grounded and put forward for testing — the phenomenon directly witnessed from both sides of these decisions across roughly twenty-five years of rationalization practice, the mechanism offered for refutation rather than claimed as proven — and states falsifiable predictions on records firms already hold: a discovery gap whose shadow set is enriched for high-contribution applications; the silence at the ownership question; a wedge between acquisition price and subsequent internal attribution; a build-versus-buy inversion traceable as rejected-build-then-external-buy of the same capability; and “rationalization scars,” critical capabilities fragmented into undocumented legacy remnants. A controlled comparison of two governance treatments — clarity-only versus revaluation-then-clarity — is the decisive test. A generalization to the wider economy is offered separately and fenced as conjecture, with its strongest rival (trade and comparative advantage) named.

relations: Institutional preservation can keep a capability available while leaving its contribution, recognition and legal rights as separate questions.
La custodia institucional no prueba contribución económica ni transfiere por sí misma todos los derechos legales.
Reducing compensatory human work and improving capability recognition are distinct outcomes that require separate measures.
HID y Attribution Gap tienen unidades distintas y no deben sumarse como una métrica única.
The attribution ratchet sharpens one incentive mechanism behind architectural complexity: blame remains attached to the source while credit is captured downstream.
Es comparación entre mecanismos, no deducción de una teoría a partir de la otra ni explicación universal de la fragmentación.
Lineage establishes dependency, while contribution still requires independently evidenced consequences, substitution conditions and a reliable scoring protocol.
No confundir dependencia técnica con valor económico absoluto ni el estimador ordinal con una tasación financiera.
The proposed sequence is to reconstruct contribution and replacement consequences before turning ownership clarity into a capability-retirement decision.
Es una hipótesis de tratamiento, no afirmación de que todo legado debe preservarse ni de que la secuencia haya demostrado superioridad general.
Before replacing a local database, reconstruct the corrections and capabilities it supports; a cleaner ownership map is not evidence that its contribution has been replaced.
No justifica conservar todo shadow IT ni desconocer riesgos reales de la base local.
Compressed accountability should not become concentrated blame without matching authority or visible contribution.
La similitud no demuestra que ese patrón exista en un contrato concreto ni traduce una aplicación directamente a una persona.
Successful engineering needs an institutional handover that preserves ownership, maintenance capacity and recognition after the intervention team leaves.
Una asignación de dueño no demuestra valor realizado y puede fallar si se impone antes de reconstruir la capacidad.
An expanding operational role can reveal previously unrecognized capability, which still requires bounded contribution and replacement evidence before being valued.
No atribución de la totalidad de PEMEX o Chicontepec a GEPLAN ni inferencia de derechos de propiedad a partir de uso.
Facilitator capability can outlast an intervention only if learning is accompanied by durable ownership, resourcing and recognition, rather than enthusiasm alone.
Relación propuesta; el caso Nestlé no aporta una medición longitudinal del vector de atribución ni prueba este efecto causal.
Diamond Inside's value-discovery proposition can be examined through the revaluation-before-clarification hypothesis without treating a potential opportunity as realized financial value.
No todos los activos ocultos son diamantes, y una contribución detectada puede ser sustituible, costosa o legítimamente prescindible.
The corridor invites a bounded attribution study of where a capability is created, maintained and capitalized, rather than inferring its value from the location that books the revenue.
La generalización transfronteriza es una hipótesis; el desempeño macro de Chicontepec no prueba extracción ni pérdida de cada capacidad local.
The transfer-compensation example shows why network value may require funding the contributing node even when its local ledger understates the benefit it creates elsewhere.
La analogía no verifica cifras históricas del fondo ni prueba que toda línea deficitaria cree valor neto para la red.
One testable link is whether the visible model receives resources and credit while the less visible capabilities on which it depends remain under-attributed.
No se infiere intención de apropiación a partir de una narrativa atractiva; se necesitan registros de contribución y atribución.
Narrative compression is one possible visibility mechanism to examine when contribution and attribution diverge; it should be traced through actual resource and authority decisions.
No toda omisión editorial es captura de valor. Se propone un mecanismo posible, no una acusación sobre actores concretos.
Authentic provenance, permission to use and contribution credit are different propositions; evidence for one should not silently decide the others.
La comparación no constituye una decisión de copyright, royalties o titularidad en un caso real.
A later economic question is whether correcting attribution changes effective withdrawal and allocation rights, rather than only symbolic credit.
El programa es propuesto; no aporta estimaciones causales sobre empresas reales.

Una contribución que circula sin ser reconocida permite leer el Attribution Gap desde la capacidad que la organización deja de percibir y, por ello, puede dejar de sostener.
El ciclo de descubrimiento, atribución y transferencia permite preguntar qué capacidad se pierde cuando solo se reconoce un resultado, pero no a quienes lo hacen posible.
